svg.text: AEGISGATE // 4-THREAD QCA FORWARD MODE & R01–R11 GATE ARCHITECTURE
LAYER 01 // QCA COORDINATOR (`aegis-coordinator` v4) + INDEPENDENT RED-TEAM ADVISOR
Routes SGT 3-Session Windows (17:00 Pre, 22:30 RTH, 05:00 Post) · Skips Nov 26 · Enforces Nov 27 Early Flatten
Golden Invariant: Executor is NEVER called unless Risk Auditor emits GATE_VERDICT: PASS (11/11)
LAYER 02 // SCOUT RESEARCHER (`aegis-scout` v2 · Zero Order Permissions)
Skills: moomoo-quote, news-search, stock-digest, comment-sentiment, unusual-technical/capital/derivatives
Computes Wilder RSI-14, ATR-14, QQQ 20-EMA Regime & 11-Sector SPDR Relative Strength -> signals/candidates.json
LAYER 03 // ISOLATED DETERMINISTIC RISK AUDITOR (`aegis-risk-auditor` v3 · 0.0066ms Gate)
R07 (>-2% Daily DD), R08 (<190/200 Orders), R09 (Option DTE>=2), R10 (ER>2d), R11 (SGT Session/Holiday Guard)
Logs ALL Approved & Rejected Proposals -> logs/decisions.jsonl + Counterfactual Saved Drawdown Scope
LAYER 04 // ORDER EXECUTOR (`aegis-executor` v2 · Dedicated SIM-COMP-5770313 Vault)
3-Rung Limit-Order Walk (Midpoint -> +50% Spread -> Ask Cap) · 20x Bar Volume Check · 5m Stop Escalation Watchdog
